verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no way to assign conversations to teammates, and nothing about shared-inbox ownership. Fastmail's Filters & Rules and Sieve filters sort mail within a personal mailbox. That is an adjacent capability: nothing shows rules routing mail to teammates or making ownership explicit, so it earns no credit for this team-collaboration story.

support.subject: As a team-lead, I can assign conversations to teammates and route incoming mail with rules so ownership is explicit
